questions.question: Which one of the following is a non-constitutional and non-statutory body?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**NITI Aayog.**__

__
 
• ** NITI Aayog;-**

 
 
• **NITI Aayog was established by the Government of India in 2015. **
 
• It is an advisory body to the government on matters of economic policy and development.
 
• **It is not a constitutional body and does not have any specific powers or functions that are mentioned in any law. (Hence Option 2 is correct)**
 
• The main purpose of NITI Aayog is to replace the Planning Commission of India.
 
• The Planning Commission was a non-statutory body that was established in 1950. It was responsible for formulating and implementing the national development plans.
 
• **However, the Planning Commission was abolished in 2014 and NITI Aayog was created in its place.**
 
• The chairman of NITI Aayog is Prime Minister of India. The chairman is assisted by a vice-chairman and a few other members.
 
• The members of NITI Aayog are drawn from different fields, such as economics, business, and government.

• It is a statutory authority established by the Government of India under the Aadhaar Act, 2016.
 
• **The UIDAI is responsible for issuing 12-digit Aadhaar numbers to all residents of India. **
 
 
 
• **National Human Rights Commission (NHRC):-**
 
 
• It is a statutory body established by the Government of India under the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993.
 
• **The NHRC is responsible for the protection of human rights in India. **
 
• It does this by investigating complaints of human rights violations, recommending measures to prevent human rights violations, and spreading awareness about human rights.
 
 
 
• **Competition Commission of India (CCI):-**
 
 
• It is an autonomous statutory body established by the Government of India under the Competition Act, 2002.
 
• **The CCI is responsible for promoting and enforcing competition in the markets of India. **
 
• It does this by preventing anti-competitive practices such as cartels, abuse of dominance, and unfair trade practices.

questions.question: ______ is a technology that allows computers and other devices to communicate via a wireless signal.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Wi-Fi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• WiFi:

 
 
• ​It is suggested that wifi stands for Wireless Fidelity.
 
• It is a wireless communication technology which enables computers and other devices to communicate through a wireless signal.
 
• Wifi technology has coverage areas of up to 300 feet (approx.. 100 meters).
 
• This means it can be used for larger distance compared to Bluetooth technology. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Electronic gadgets enable people to communicate with each other irrespective of their geographic location and distance.
 
• All technologies can be broadly classified into – **wired and Wireless.**
 
• Wired technologies use cables whereas wireless technologies use radio frequency to enable one or more devices to communicate without any physical connections.
 
• Bluetooth:
 
 
• Bluetooth technology was created by a telecom company called Ericsson in 1994.
 
• It is a wireless medium for sharing information built into electronic devices like mobile phones, Personal Digital Assistants (PDAs) etc.
 
• There is no cable or modem or driver to be installed.
 
• It can work in a concise range for example only within the room.
 
• It a short-range wireless convergent technology.
 
• It is a low-power radio technology covering a small range of distances up to 10 metres or 30 feet approx.
 
• This technology has been adopted to many products such as earphones, in-car systems, printer, keyboard, and mouse.
 
 
 
• Infrared:
 
 
• ​It is another wireless technology that uses infrared radiation for wireless transmission between computer devices as well as many handheld remotes for TVs and video and stereo equipment.
 
• Infrared adapters are installed on many laptops and smartphones.
 
 
 
• Modem:
 
 
• ​Modems can be wired or wireless.
 
• It converts the digital signal from the computer into an analogue signal that can travel through the telephone line.
 
• On the other end, this analogue signal is again converted back to digital form by the modem at the destination end.

• After flowing through Tibet it enters India through Arunachal Pradesh and flows through Assam and Bangladesh before it joins Bay of Bengal.
 
• **​**The Brahmaputra River System (3848 km) is one of the longest rivers of the world. It is known as the **Yarlung Tsangpo River in Tibet**, the **Brahmaputra, Lohit, Siang, and Dihang in India**, and the **Jamuna in Bangladesh**.

questions.question: At Devprayag (Uttarakhand), which of the following two rivers confluence and form river Ganga?

__
 
• **Alaknanda and Bhagirathi:**

 
 
• Devprayag is a significant pilgrimage site in Uttarakhand, India.
 
• It is one of the five "Prayags" (confluences) where major rivers meet.
 
• At Devprayag, the Alaknanda and Bhagirathi rivers converge.
 
• This confluence is considered the origin point of the Ganga River.
 
• The Bhagirathi is often considered the primary source stream of the Ganga, originating from the Gangotri Glacier.
 
• The Alaknanda originates from the Satopanth Glacier.
 
• The meeting of these two rivers is a visually striking event.
 
• Devprayag is a town nestled amidst the hills, offering scenic views.
 
• The confluence holds deep religious and cultural importance for Hindus.
 
• Pilgrims frequently visit Devprayag to witness the confluence and bathe in the holy waters.
 
• The Ganga, formed at Devprayag, is one of India's most sacred and important rivers.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• The confluence of the Yamuna and Ganga is also a significant pilgrimage site.
 
 
 
• **Bhagirathi and Yamuna:**
 
 
• As mentioned above, the Yamuna meets the Ganga at Prayagraj, not Devprayag.
 
• The Bhagirathi and Yamuna do *not* meet at Devprayag.
 
 
 
• **Yamuna and Gomti:**

• It meets the Ganga in Uttar Pradesh, not in Uttarakhand.
 
• The Yamuna and Gomti do *not* meet at Devprayag.

questions.question: The average of 13 numbers is 22. If each number is multiplied by 3, what will be the new average?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If each number in a given set is multiplied by a certain constant, the new average is simply the old average multiplied by the same constant.

New Average = Old Average × Constant

New Average = 22 × 3 = 66

**∴ The correct answer is 66.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 13 numbers = 22

Constant multiplier for each number = 3

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations

 Property of Averages
 
 Original Average:
 
 22
 
 
• 
 

 Each number × 3
 
 New Average:
 
 66 (i.e. 22 × 3)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of the original 13 numbers = Average × Total numbers

⇒ Original Sum = 22 × 13 = 286

⇒ When each individual number is multiplied by 3, the total sum is also multiplied by 3.

⇒ New Sum = Original Sum × 3

⇒ New Sum = 286 × 3 = 858

⇒ New Average = New Sum ÷ Total numbers

⇒ New Average = 858 ÷ 13 = 66

**∴ The correct answer is 66.**

Addition and Subtraction Property

If a constant value 'k' is added to or subtracted from each observation in a dataset, the new average becomes (Old Average + k) or (Old Average − k).

Multiplication and Division Property

If each observation is multiplied or divided by a non-zero constant 'k', the new average becomes (Old Average × k) or (Old Average ÷ k).

Combined Average

Given equation: 5⁽x ⁺ ¹⁾ + 5⁽² − x⁾ = 5³ + 1

The RHS can be expressed as a sum of powers of 5: 125 + 1 = 5³ + 5⁰.

Comparing the powers of 5 on both sides:

Case 2: x + 1 = 0 and 2 − x = 3 ⇒ x = −1

questions.question: The digit in the unit place of 1⁵ + 2⁵ + ... + 99⁵
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The unit digit of any number n⁵ is the same as the unit digit of n because the cyclicity of unit digits is 4.

So, the unit digit of 1⁵ + 2⁵ + ... + 99⁵ is the same as the unit digit of the sum 1 + 2 + ... + 99.

Sum of first 99 natural numbers = 99 × 100 ÷ 2 = 4950.

The unit digit of 4950 is 0.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: 1⁵ + 2⁵ + 3⁵ + ... + 99⁵

**Formula Used:**

Sum of first n natural numbers = n(n + 1) ÷ 2

**Calculations:**

⇒ The unit digit of a number repeats after every 4th power (cyclicity = 4).

⇒ Since 5 divided by 4 leaves a remainder of 1, the unit digit of n⁵ is identical to the unit digit of n¹.

⇒ Therefore, the unit digit of the entire expression is exactly the same as the unit digit of the sum: (1 + 2 + 3 + ... + 99).

⇒ Substituting n = 99 into the sum formula:

⇒ Sum = 99 × (99 + 1) ÷ 2

⇒ Sum = 99 × 100 ÷ 2

⇒ Sum = 99 × 50

⇒ Sum = 4950

⇒ Looking at the calculated sum, the digit in the unit place is 0.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Digit Cyclicity

questions.question: If 0.3overline {72} = (x)/(y), where x and y are coprime, then what is the value of (x + y) ?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Convert mixed recurring decimal 0.372 directly to a fraction:

Numerator = Total digits − Non-repeating digits = 372 − 3 = 369

Denominator = 99 (for two repeating digits) followed by 0 (for one non-repeating digit) = 990

Fraction = 369 ÷ 990 = 41 ÷ 110

Since x and y are coprime, x = 41 and y = 110, giving (x + y) = 151.

**∴ The correct answer is 151.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x ÷ y = 0.372

Let N = 0.3727272...

⇒ 10N = 3.727272... (Equation 1)

⇒ 1000N = 372.727272... (Equation 2)

Subtracting Equation 1 from Equation 2:

⇒ 1000N − 10N = 372.727272... − 3.727272...

⇒ 990N = 369

⇒ N = 369 ÷ 990

⇒ N = 41 ÷ 110

Since x and y are coprime, we can equate x = 41 and y = 110.

⇒ (x + y) = 41 + 110 = 151

**∴ The correct answer is 151.**

**__Additional Information__**

Pure Recurring Decimal

A decimal where all digits after the decimal point are repeated. To convert, place the repeating digits in the numerator and an equal number of 9s in the denominator (e.g., 0.4545... = 45 ÷ 99).

Mixed Recurring Decimal

A decimal where some digits after the decimal point do not repeat. The denominator will have 9s equal to the repeating digits and 0s equal to the non-repeating digits.

Coprime Numbers

Two numbers are coprime if their highest common factor (HCF) is 1. They do not necessarily need to be prime numbers themselves (e.g., 8 and 15 are coprime).

At marriage, ratio = 5 : 3. Difference = 2 parts = 8 years, so 1 part = 4 years.

Age of Mr. X at marriage = 5 × 4 = 20 years. Years since marriage = 32 − 20 = 12 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 years.**

Let the present ages of Mr. X and his wife be 4x and 3x respectively.

After 4 years, their ages will be (4x + 4) and (3x + 4).

⇒ (4x + 4) ÷ (3x + 4) = 9 ÷ 7

⇒ 28x + 28 = 27x + 36

⇒ 28x − 27x = 36 − 28

⇒ x = 8

⇒ 96 − 3y = 120 − 5y

⇒ 2y = 24

⇒ y = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12 years.**

The absolute difference between the ages of two individuals always remains constant regardless of the time period.

Check if the first divisor is completely divisible by the second divisor.

**Formula Used:**

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder

**Calculation:**

Let the number be N and the quotient be q.

⇒ N = 512q + 67

We need to find the remainder when N is divided by 32.

Rewrite the equation in terms of 32:

⇒ N = (32 × 16q) + (32 × 2) + 3

⇒ N = 32(16q + 2) + 3

Let (16q + 2) = k, where k is an integer.

⇒ N = 32k + 3

This shows that when N is divided by 32, the quotient is k and the remainder is 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**
